original_record.ai_explanation: An agent can only be rewarded through payment of commission and salary as stipulated by the principal, and must not retain secret profits.

original_record.ai_explanation: Termination by frustration occurs when an unforeseen event beyond the parties' control (theft) makes contract performance impossible without default.
